simple.meaning: מִכְמֶרֶת (mikmereth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a (fisher's) net.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H4365. mikmereth [ מִכְמֶ֫רֶת ] noun feminine net, fishing-net ; singular suffix מִכְמַרְתּוֺ Hab 1:15 (|| חַכָּה , and חֵרֶם ), 1:16 , both in figure of conquering Chaldeans. מִכְמֹ֫רֶת noun feminine id.; מ ׳וּפֹרְשֵׂי עַלמְּֿנֵימּמַיִם Isa 19:8 (|| חַכָּה בַיְאוֺר מַשְׁלִיכֵי ).

occurrences.englishText: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.
He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net, and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
Therefore he sacrifices to his net, and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious, and his food is good.
